text_block_list.text:
Today is the photoshoot for a magazine feature.
Along with the horse girls modeling for it,
I ended up tagging along as support.

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for participating
in "Special Feature: Engage Dress-Up"!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The shooting location is... a church far away, right.

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, we plan on taking frequent breaks!
Let's head over while staying relaxed!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's take it easy~.
Go leisurely, shoot leisurely~.

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
First, let's take a break on this meadow!
We have picnic mats, so
please rest and shake off the bus fatigue~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, feels nice...
Perhaps I'll take a short nap.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! B-Bugs!!
There are bugs here, aren't there!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm, great outdoors indeed.
A deep breath really cleanses the soul~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Who knew fishing bug spray would come in handy...
Ah, King, want some too?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you...
You really are resourceful when it comes to slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no~.
I just happened to have this on me, that's all~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next was a break in an unused studio—
if I recall the schedule correctly.
(KABOOM! Ta-da-da-daaan!)

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry,
a tokusatsu filming got scheduled at short notice...
I am truly, terribly sorry for all the noise!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No worries. —By the way, Director-san?
Does this studio happen to have a dressing room~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If we're away from the set, it should be quiet...
Sei-chan might just take a quick nap there♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hot, it's so hot hot hot~!
It's supposed to be a rest stop, but I'm gonna get sunburned!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha♪ Sweep, want some too?
If fishing sunscreen works for you, that is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
After that, let's hit a beach shack...
Feel the sea breeze while eating grilled corn, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To think the driver would get lost and force us to camp out.
—Everyone being safe is our only saving grace.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I went fishing for a bit.
Since we're here, should we have grilled fish for dinner~?

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! After quite a long journey, at last!
We have... arrived at the location... but!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm so tiiiired!
There's no waaaay I'm doing the shoot!

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You must all be exhausted from the trip!
Please, rest to your heart's content!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... since this is an important shoot,
I'd like to take a break and look absolute perfection.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I agree with taking a short break as well.
...Speaking of which, where is Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes~, right here.
Sei-chan has arrived~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sky... you're composed no matter where you go.
Don't tell me you took a break here too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No, no. I finished changing early,
so I was just making friends with the shade in the garden~!

text_block_list.name: Earnest Director
text_block_list.text:
S-Sky-san...!
To maintain your condition through masterclass relaxing,
that's already the mentality of a pro model...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, a model~?
Even I get embarrassed hearing that.

Afterward, Seiun Sky continued to maintain her pace
with skillful breaks, powering through the long photoshoot in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Just as I thought.
Good grief, you really are something else.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~n♪ Air Groove-san, want to relax too
until your turn for shooting comes?

Afterward, Seiun Sky took breaks skillfully
and managed to power through the long photoshoot.
